title: Wings live: Capitol Theatre, Aberdeen | 1975
content:
Wings performed at the Capital Theatre in Aberdeen, Scotland, on 22 September 1975.

It was the 12th night of the 65-date Wings Over The World Tour, which ran from September 1975 to October 1976.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Jimmy McCulloch on guitar and vocals; and Joe English on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.

Following this show, Paul McCartney wrote the London Town song ‘Don’t Let It Bring You Down’.

We were on tour in Scotland, and we’re having quite a time of it. We were up in Aberdeen, and I was sitting in a hotel bedroom just before we were gonna turn in for the night, and I had my 12-string guitar with me. And I just started plonking out a little tune, and it became ‘Don’t Let It Bring You Down’.
Paul McCartney
London Town Special, KRTH-101, 25 March 1978

Kozinn, Allan; Sinclair, Adrian. The McCartney Legacy: Volume 2: 1974 – 80 (p. 287). (Function). Kindle Edition.
